title: Trained MaleCNS - Front Nine
description: The trained golfer plays round seed 7, the project's default seed, fixed before the round was played. Every stroke starts from 400 ms of simulated activity across all 166,700 MaleCNS neurons; a readout fitted offline from practice shots (readout 20260913T220118Z) turns descending-neuron firing into a club, an aim and a power. The connectome itself never learns.

controller.label: MaleCNS + TRAINED READOUT
controller.description: The same MaleCNS v1.0 connectome simulation. Club, aim and power are read out of descending-neuron activity by weights fitted offline from practice shots (a putter gate, a club head and putter / full-swing heads; docs/TRAINING.md). The connectome's synapses are unchanged.

notes: trajectory samples rounded to 4 decimals (0.1 mm, 0.1 ms) for size; the source run re-simulates bit for bit with `fly-golf replay 20260914T115447Z-e62f18`

controller.label: MaleCNS + TRAINED READOUT
controller.description: The same MaleCNS v1.0 connectome simulation. Club, aim and power are read out of descending-neuron activity by weights fitted offline from practice shots (a putter gate, a club head and putter / full-swing heads; docs/TRAINING.md). The connectome's synapses are unchanged.

club_chain.senses: proxy sensory channels injected into MaleCNS sensory neurons; 400 ms simulated
club_chain.rule: putter if p_putt >= 0.5, else club index = round(calibrated club head), lob wedge..driver
